title: Introducing HALC: A general pipeline for the systematic and reliable construction of prompts for automated coding with LLMs in the computational social sciences
abstract: arXiv:2507.21831v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs are seeing widespread use for task automation, including automated coding in the social sciences. However, even though researchers have proposed different prompting strategies, their effectiveness varies across LLMs and tasks. Often trial and error practices are still widespread. Our study aims to fill this gap and evaluate how LLMs can be used in a systematic and transparent way to produce reliable codings in content analyses. We propose HALC-a general pipeline that allows for the systematic and reliable construction of prompts for any given coding task and model. We develop this pipeline based on current literature and findings of a prestudy investigating consistency and influencing factors of LLM codings. We also apply HALC on two other datasets covering different thematic contexts, document types, languages, and coding units to test its applicability. translated_title: HALC简介：一个用于计算社会科学中大语言模型自动编码的提示词系统化、可靠化构建的通用流程
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正被广泛用于任务自动化，包括社会科学中的自动编码。然而，尽管研究人员已经提出了不同的提示策略，但其有效性因LLM和任务的不同而各异，试错式的实践仍然普遍存在。我们的研究旨在填补这一空白，评估如何以系统和透明的方式使用LLM，从而在内容分析中产生可靠的编码结果。我们提出了HALC——一个通用流程，能够为任何给定的编码任务和模型进行系统化、可靠化的提示词构建。我们基于现有文献以及一项调查LLM编码一致性和影响因素的预研究结果开发了该流程。我们还将HALC应用于另外两个数据集，涵盖不同的主题背景、文档类型、语言和编码单元，以检验其适用性。基于超过三百万次LLM请求，我们的结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出了HALC通用流程，可为计算社会科学中的LLM自动编码任务系统、可靠地构建提示词，并通过超过三百万次LLM请求在不同数据集上验证了其适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HALC, a general pipeline that enables systematic and reliable prompt construction for LLM-based automated coding in computational social sciences, validated across multiple datasets based on over three million LLM requests.
